source: Browser microphone recording uploaded through Streamlit — not continuous live telemetry
formulas: 0 dBFS is RMS=1 under this digital convention; a peak-amplitude-1 sine has RMS level about −3.0103 dBFS. Silence has no finite logarithm; null means digital silence, NOT 0 dB.
reliability: Digital amplitude measurement only. Absolute SPL, frequency response and physical accuracy are not established.
limitations: Not dBA/dBC and not calibrated sound pressure. WAV gain, microphone processing, distance and source affect levels.
Peak is sample peak, NOT intersample true peak or certified acoustic peak.
Intervals are 0.25 seconds (last may be shorter); no IEC Fast/Slow or A/C weighting is claimed.
Near-full-scale samples flag possible clipping; actual analog clipping may occur below that point.
Streamlit analyses completed recordings, not continuously streamed microphone telemetry.
Microphone recordings are sent to the server. Browser/device processing and encoding may alter gain; physical acoustic calibration is not established.
